info.name: Oracle EBS Supply Chain Management API
info.description:
RESTful APIs for Oracle E-Business Suite supply chain management modules including Purchasing, Order Management, Inventory, and Logistics. These PL/SQL APIs are deployed as REST services through the Integrated SOA Gateway.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Support
 Email: support@oracle.com
